parsed_json.up: Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id prefixed with 'EFO:'), indication_label (mesh_heading), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: mesh_heading = 'chronic kidney disease'; max_phase_for_ind = 4. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
